title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the functional study hubs, quiet retreats, and collaborative spaces that Carnegie Mellon students use to navigate their rigorous academic schedules.

cards.title: Collaborative Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Hunt Library
cards.notes: Utilize the newly renovated collaborative spaces on the fourth floor for group projects and interactive study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A recently updated floor in the main library dedicated to collaborative student work and group study.
cards.evidence_claim: The fourth floor of Hunt Library features a new collaborative study space that can be reserved through the library system.
cards.access_notes: Open until 3:00 AM most nights during the fall semester.

cards.title: Citadel Teaching Commons
cards.subtitle: Gates and Hillman Centers
cards.notes: Head to this open gathering space for peer-to-peer assistance and collaborative homework sessions in the School of Computer Science.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated collaborative environment for students to work together with peer and TA support.
cards.evidence_claim: The Citadel Teaching Commons in the Gates and Hillman Centers offers a unique environment for students to collaborate with peers and TAs.
cards.access_notes: Primarily serves School of Computer Science students but located in a public campus building.

cards.title: Tepper Quad Atrium
cards.subtitle: Tepper Building
cards.notes: Find flexible seating and social interaction zones in this massive, sunlit common area designed for collaboration.
cards.short_summary: A 315,000-square-foot facility featuring a full-height atrium with sweeping staircases and open study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tepper Quad features a full-height atrium with flexible spaces that promote social interaction and collaboration.
cards.source_title: Tepper Quad - Campus Design and Facility Development
cards.access_notes: Includes a fitness center and cafe; open to the campus community.

cards.title: CUC Interview and Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Cohon University Center
cards.notes: Access one of 25 walk-in study rooms equipped with whiteboards for focused individual or small group work.
cards.short_summary: A set of 25 reservable and walk-in rooms in the student union designed for quiet study and interviews.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cohon Center offers 25 interview and study rooms available to all CMU students on a walk-in basis during the semester.
cards.source_title: Interview and Study Rooms - Jared L. Cohon University Center
cards.access_notes: Open until 11:30 PM on Sundays; walk-in only during standard hours.

cards.title: Kraus Campo Rooftop Garden
cards.subtitle: Posner Center
cards.notes: Walk through this meditative rooftop structural garden for a quiet outdoor break between the CFA and Posner Hall.
cards.short_summary: A unique rooftop garden designed by artist Mel Bochner, serving as a meditative outdoor space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Posner Center's rooftop features the Kraus Campo, a meditative outdoor space created by artist Melvin Bochner.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor garden accessible to the public; building interior by appointment or for special collections.

cards.title: The Portal at Sorrells
cards.subtitle: Wean Hall
cards.notes: Visit the fourth floor of Wean Hall to study in 'The Portal,' a specialized area within the engineering and science library.
cards.short_summary: A distinctive study feature within the Roger Sorrells Engineering and Science Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Portal is a unique feature of Sorrells Library, which is located on the fourth floor of Wean Hall.
cards.source_title: Study in the Portal at Sorrells Library
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Monday through Thursday during the fall semester.

cards.title: ANSYS Maker Courtyard
cards.subtitle: ANSYS Hall
cards.notes: Observe large-scale student prototypes like solar boats in this outdoor extension of the first-floor maker space.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor courtyard designed for full-size manufacturing and showcasing large student engineering projects.
cards.evidence_claim: ANSYS Hall incorporates a maker assembly space with immediate access to the outdoor Maker Courtyard.
cards.source_title: Ansys Hall - Campus Design and Facility Development
cards.access_notes: The courtyard is a direct extension of the first-floor High Bay Maker Space.

cards.title: Neighborhood Commons
cards.subtitle: Hamerschlag House
cards.notes: Relax by the indoor/outdoor fireplace or use the covered workspace in this newly renovated residential hub.
cards.short_summary: A community space featuring a fireplace, art space, and study areas nestled under Hamerschlag House.
cards.evidence_claim: The Margaret Morrison Street Neighborhood Commons offers a large, covered outdoor workspace with an indoor/outdoor fireplace.
cards.access_notes: Open to all Carnegie Mellon students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Mellon Institute Library
cards.subtitle: Mellon Institute
cards.notes: Seek out this quiet, often-empty library for focused study if you have clearance to enter the Mellon Institute.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library known among students for being a quiet and less-crowded study destination.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mellon Institute Library is accessible to Mellon affiliates and is noted by students as a quiet study spot.
cards.source_title: Find a quiet study space in Mellon Institute Library
cards.access_notes: Access is restricted to those with clearance to enter the Mellon Institute building.

cards.title: Newell-Simon Atrium
cards.subtitle: Newell-Simon Hall
cards.notes: Study in the bright, open atrium near the iNoodle cafe, a popular spot for students working in the Robotics Institute.
cards.short_summary: A large, sunlit atrium space frequently used by students for studying and dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Newell-Simon Hall features a great place to study in an atrium located off the main entrance from Forbes Avenue.
cards.source_title: Alternative places to study at CMU
cards.access_notes: Contains the iNoodle dining location; accessible during building hours.
